newsitem.title: USA: U.S. aluminum shipments up 8.5 percent in August.
newsitem.headline: U.S. aluminum shipments up 8.5 percent in August.

text.p: U.S. aluminum industry shipments, including exports, rose 8.5 percent to 1.856 billion lbs in August from the prior month's revised total of 1.711 billion lbs, U.S. Aluminum Association reported.
August shipments were 7.4 percent higher than in the same month last year.
Total net industry shipments in the first eight months of 1996 were 12.03 billion lbs, down 3.9 percent from last year's tally.
U.S. exports of aluminum ingot and mill products were 225 million lbs in August, 6.9 percent higher than in July. Imports in August totaled 456 million lbs, 4.6 percent higher than the prior month.
Estimated industry net new orders of aluminum mill products, totalling 1.24 billion pounds in September, declined 5.2 percent from the August level of 1.308 billion lbs.
In September, new orders for domestic can stock fell 8.9 percent while orders for other sheet and plate decreased 3.9 percent from August.
U.S. producer inventory fell 104 million lbs to 4.2 billion lbs in August, made up of 1.469 billion lbs of ingot, 756 million lbs of scrap and 1.986 billion lbs of aluminum in other forms.
Scrap consumptions totaled 725 million lbs in August, up 8.2 percent over the same month last year.
